items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: But I think he's responsible for any beat that I have today, really.

ctx.x: Did he teach you many different rhythms? He specialized in one particular type of rhythm.
Mostly one particular type of rhythm, of course, is the one that Lewis has known so well for, that straightforward beat. But I think he's responsible for any beat that I have today, really.
When did you start playing with bands?
